import Mathlib

open Filter

theorem real_sequence_tendsto_iff_eventually_pairwise_close
    (xSeq : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto xSeq Filter.atTop (nhds x) ↔
      ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∀ n m : ℕ, N < n → N < m → |xSeq n - xSeq m| < ε :=
by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    have hpos : ε / 2 > 0 := by linarith
    have := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h (ε / 2) hpos
    rcases this with ⟨N, hN⟩
    refine ⟨N + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro n hn m hm
    have hn' : N ≤ n := by omega
    have hm' : N ≤ m := by omega
    have h1 : |xSeq n - x| < ε / 2 := hN n hn'
    have h2 : |xSeq m - x| < ε / 2 := hN m hm'
    calc
      |xSeq n - xSeq m| = |(xSeq n - x) - (xSeq m - x)| := by ring
      _ ≤ |xSeq n - x| + |xSeq m - x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := by linarith
      _ = ε := by ring
  · intro h
    sorry
